capabilities: Render .html, .mhtml/.mht, and .webarchive files in tabs or inline embeds
Open Evernote .enex exports read-only with original formatting preserved
Insert inline previews using the ![[File.html]] embed syntax
Strip scripts and network-requesting content from rendered embeds
Guide capturing web clips via Safari Web Archive and Chromium Save Page As
extras: ENEX support is limited: only single-note files render, some elements (tables of contents, inline tags, non-image attachments) are unsupported, and web archive files can slow the vault. The plugin was installed via BRAT before joining the community repository.
intentEvidence: extend the compatible file types that can be rendered natively inside Obsidian
problem: Obsidian cannot render web archive formats like .mhtml, .webarchive, or Evernote .enex exports natively in notes.
summary: Format renderer that embeds and previews HTML, MHTML, Apple Web Archive, and Evernote ENEX files natively in Obsidian.
